title: Add ref.mounted/context.mounted guards after awaits in RewardConfigController and the pending-redemptions fulfil/decline handlers
rule: SM-4 (after any await in a Notifier method/async callback, check ref.mounted before touching ref/state)
why: RewardConfigController is an autoDispose Notifier (confirmed via reward_config_controller.g.dart: isAutoDispose: true) whose saveReward/toggleEnabled/deleteMilestone/_persistAndSync methods each await one or more DB/network calls and then read `state` or call `ref.invalidate`/`ref.read` afterward -- with zero ref.mounted checks anywhere in the file (grep confirms). If the user saves/toggles/deletes and the screen is popped (e.g. the success dialog's own navigation, or a fast back-gesture) before the await resolves, Riverpod 3 throws when a disposed Ref is touched. The same shape recurs in parent_pending_redemptions_screen.dart's _fulfil/_decline: `ref.invalidate` runs BEFORE the `context.mounted` check that appears one statement later in the same function -- the check exists, it's just ordered too late. By contrast, every other async flow in this exact feature (child_redemption_screen.dart, achievement_unlock_celebration.dart, reward_configuration_screen.dart) consistently checks mounted immediately after every await, so this is a real, demonstrated-known-pattern that these two files skip. No test in reward_config_controller_test.dart exercises container/widget disposal mid-await (grep for 'Unmounted'/dispose-mid-call found nothing).
recommendation: Add `if (!ref.mounted) return;` immediately after every await in RewardConfigController's mutation methods before touching state/ref again; in parent_pending_redemptions_screen.dart move `ref.invalidate(...)` after the `context.mounted` check, not before it.
acceptance_criteria: Every await in RewardConfigController's saveReward/toggleEnabled/deleteMilestone/_persistAndSync is followed by a ref.mounted check before further ref/state use
parent_pending_redemptions_screen.dart's _fulfil/_decline check context.mounted before ref.invalidate, not after
A widget/provider test disposes the container or pops the screen mid-await and asserts no uncaught disposed-ref exception
